title: 第104章 打断施法小白建功第103章 飞剑枭首不留全尸
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
溶洞入口，结界残骸边缘。
冷汗浸透了王腾的后背。汗水混合着脖颈处溢出的鲜血，顺着脊椎骨一路滑入冰冷的内甲。
血腥味直冲鼻腔。
他双膝跪在碎石地上，大口大口地喘气。每一次呼吸，肺叶都会传来撕裂般的剧痛。
左手死死捏着那张银色的高阶空间传送卷轴。
卷轴表面，繁复的空间阵纹亮起刺目的白光。一股强大的空间拉扯力，在王腾的身体四周汇聚，形成一个半透明的光茧。
只要再过半息。光茧闭合。他就能无视任何物理封锁，随机传送到百里之外的安全区。
生存的希望近在咫尺。恐惧退潮，怨毒与杀意重新占据了大脑的高地。
王腾猛地抬起头。
双眼充血，布满红色的血丝。死死盯着三十丈外那道隐藏在阴影中的黑色身影。
“厉飞雨！我记住你的防毒面罩了！我记住你的重剑了！”
沙哑嘶厉的咆哮声在溶洞内回荡。音波震落了岩壁上的几块碎石。
“神宗绝不放过你！老子出去后，立刻在世界频道发布全服最高级别的血杀令！十万不够就一百万！我要让你在这大荒域寸步难行，杀到你删号退游！”
歇斯底里的诅咒，透着大公会核心天骄独有的傲慢与底气。
空间光茧的光芒愈发刺目。王腾的身影在白光中扭曲、模糊。传送机制只差最后的读条。
三十丈外。碳化枯树的阴影下。
苏寒安静地站立。
耳畔萦绕着王腾的诅咒。鼻腔里充斥着空气中弥漫的血雾腥味。
他的呼吸依旧平稳，维持在一炷香一次的寂灭频率。那双漆黑的眼眸，没有波澜。
躲在暗处的刺客，最忌讳被猎物留下任何身份标识。

“废话真多。”
冰冷的四个字，在防毒面罩内沉闷作响。
没有任何施法动作。没有真气外放的光影。
半空中。
一直处于隐身状态的二阶巅峰噬金虫王，小白，接收到了主人的绝对意志。
它身披极寒冥铁打造的隐形战甲，完美隔绝了一切神识与光线的探查。
双翅高频振动。
空气中没有气流的呼啸。只有一道肉眼绝对无法捕捉的致命轨迹，撕裂了三十丈的空间。
王腾的嘴角勾起一抹劫后余生的狞笑。
五指发力，准备进行最后的数据确认。
就在这一瞬。
一点微不可察的暗金光芒，在传送光茧的内部，凭空亮起。
“噗嗤！”
一声沉闷的骨肉穿透声。
小白那对无坚不摧的暗金色口器，带着摧枯拉朽的动能，直接洞穿了王腾的左手手腕！
皮肉被撕裂。腕骨被生生咬碎。
毒素与麻痹感顺着断裂的神经末梢，疯狂涌入王腾的大脑中枢。
content_en:
The cave entrance, the edge of the barrier debris.
Cold sweat soaked Wang Teng's back. Sweat mixed with the blood that overflowed from his neck, sliding down his spine and into the cold inner armor.
The smell of blood rushed straight into the nose.
He knelt on the gravel, gasping for air. Every time I took a breath, there was a sharp pain like tearing in my lungs.
The silver high-level space teleportation scroll was tightly held in his left hand.
On the surface of the scroll, the complex spatial formations lit up with dazzling white light. A powerful spatial pulling force gathered around Wang Teng's body, forming a translucent cocoon of light.
Just half a breath more. The cocoon of light closes. He can ignore any physical blockade and randomly teleport to a safe zone hundreds of miles away.
The hope of survival is close at hand. The fear subsided, and resentment and murderous intent reoccupied the high ground of the brain.
Wang Teng raised his head suddenly.
The eyes were bloodshot and covered with red bloodshot eyes. Staring at the black figure hidden in the shadows thirty feet away.
"Li Feiyu! I remember your gas mask! I remember your epee!"
A hoarse roar echoed in the cave. The sound waves shook several pieces of gravel off the rock wall.
"Shenzong will never let you go! After I leave, I will immediately issue the highest-level blood killing order in the world channel! One hundred thousand is not enough, one million! I will make it difficult for you to move in this wilderness, and I will kill you until you delete your account and quit the game!"
The hysterical curse revealed the unique arrogance and confidence of the core genius of the Grand Guild.
The light of the space light cocoon became more and more dazzling. Wang Teng's figure was distorted and blurred in the white light. The only thing missing from the delivery mechanism is the final reading.
Thirty feet away. In the shadow of carbonized dead trees.
Su Han stood quietly.
Wang Teng's curse lingered in his ears. The nostrils were filled with the smell of blood mist in the air.
His breathing was still steady, maintaining the frequency of death once per incense stick. Those dark eyes were unruffled.
Assassins who hide in the dark are most afraid of being left with any identification marks by their prey.
"So much nonsense."
The four cold words sounded dull inside the gas mask.
There is no casting action. There is no light and shadow of the true energy released.
Mid-air.
The second-order peak gold-eating insect king, Xiaobai, who has been in a state of invisibility, has received the absolute will of his master.
It wears an invisible armor made of extremely cold Hades iron, which perfectly isolates it from all detection of spiritual consciousness and light.
The wings vibrate at high frequencies.
There was no roar of air in the air. There was only a fatal trajectory that could never be caught by the naked eye, tearing apart thirty feet of space.
The corners of Wang Teng's lips curled up into a sinister smile that would last for a lifetime.
Use your five fingers to prepare for the final data confirmation.
Just at this moment.
An imperceptible dark golden light lit up out of thin air inside the teleportation light cocoon.
"Pfft!"
There was a dull sound of flesh and bone penetrating.
Xiaobai's pair of indestructible dark golden mouthparts, with devastating kinetic energy, directly penetrated Wang Teng's left wrist!
Flesh torn. The wrist bones were bitten to pieces.
Toxins and paralysis flowed into Wang Teng's brain center along the broken nerve endings.
